situation:
You are to assume the role of assistant store director at BRIGHT ANCHOR TOYS, a profitable chain of eleven toy stores whose founder plans to sell the business within the year. The founder (judge) has asked you to recommend what the chain does with its play floor before buyers review the coming quarter.

Bright Anchor has never competed on price. Families come for the open play floor, where staff demonstrate games and run weekend birthday parties, and they buy their gifts on the way out. The play floor sells nothing itself, and the buyers looking at the chain measure what each square foot of a store earns.

Filling the play floor with holiday merchandise for the quarter would lift the figures those buyers see. It would also cost the parties already booked and the demonstrations that bring the same families back in the spring. The demonstration lead, who has run that floor for twenty years, said little when the plan was described but made the disagreement plain.

The founder (judge) wants your recommendation on whether the floor is converted, and on what is said to the demonstration lead either way. Leaving the floor as it is holds the quarter's revenue down in front of the buyers. The founder (judge) will greet you and ask to hear your ideas, and will thank you after your presentation and questions.
judgeCharacterization:
